newsitem.title: FRANCE: Axa will not sell treasury stock - chairman.
newsitem.headline: Axa will not sell treasury stock - chairman.

text.p: French insurer Axa has no intention of selling its treasury stock, which has reached 7.8 percent of its equity capital, chairman Claude Bebear said on Wednesday.
Axa's treasury stock has risen following the recent purchase of its own shares from Italian insurer Generali, which wanted to leave Axa's group of stable shareholders.
Axa's holding of its own shares was important and Bebear told an analysts meeting that he had no intention of putting the stock on the market.
The stock gave Axa the advantage of responding quickly in the event of an acquisition and offering an exchange of shares, but he added that no such deal was being planned at the moment.

"We can use the shares if there is a big transaction but we have absolutely no intention of turning it into cash." he said. There are no big deals going on at the moment but something could crop in the future, he added.
